content: Tailwind v4 (currently 4.3.3) supports arbitrary background-image values (bg-linear-[...], bg-[image:...]) and CSS-variable-backed utilities (bg-linear-(--my-gradient), bg-size-(--my-image-size)) defined via @theme custom properties -- grid/blueprint/scanline patterns can be built natively with repeating-linear-gradient as a @theme token and applied via arbitrary bg utilities, no plugin dependency required. Dedicated plugins (tailwindcss-bg-patterns, tailwind-dot-grid-backgrounds) exist for convenience but add a dependency for something 1-2 CSS custom properties already cover.
